en.title: 7 Cheesy Christmas Movies You Can't Miss in 2026
en.summary: Get ready for your holiday movie marathon! We've rounded up the most delightfully cheesy Christmas films hitting screens in 2026, ensuring your festive season is packed with fun, romance, and a sprinkle of holiday magic.
en.body:
## 1. Our Little Secret
Lindsay Lohan is back to charm us in this Netflix original, reuniting with Ian Harding for a friends-to-lovers tale that promises all the cozy holiday feels. It’s the perfect blend of familiar faces and a classic rom-com setup, designed to deliver that warm, fuzzy Christmas glow.

## 2. The 12 Dates of Christmas
Lucy Hale and Ian Harding star in this Hulu and Disney+ offering, where a promise to her mother sends Christina Walker on a quest for love through a dozen holiday dates. Expect plenty of comedic missteps and potential sparks as she navigates the dating scene in the weeks leading up to Christmas.

## 3. Ebenezer
For those craving a darker, more theatrical Christmas, "Ebenezer" brings a horror-tinged adaptation of Dickens' classic to the big screen. Starring Johnny Depp, this isn't your typical tinsel-covered tale, offering a chilling, genre-bending twist on a timeless story.

## 4. Karen Kingsbury's The Christmas Ring
PureFlix is home to this family-centric film, centered around a mysterious Christmas ring that’s said to bring about miraculous events. If you're looking for a heartwarming story with a touch of the extraordinary to uplift your spirits, this is it.

## 5. Violent Night 2
David Harbour returns as the ass-kicking Santa Claus in "Violent Night 2," hitting theaters on December 4th. Get ready for more over-the-top action and yuletide vengeance as Santa Claus battles new threats, proving that even a jolly old elf can pack a serious punch.

## 6. Christmas at the Kringles
This slasher comedy offers a decidedly twisted take on holiday cheer, featuring Ron Livingston and Thomas Lennon. When the Kringle family, obsessed with the holidays, decides to turn their neighbors into unwilling participants in their festive traditions, things get hilariously (and terrifyingly) out of hand.

## 7. Arctic Christmas Cruise
When a father and daughter find themselves stranded in the vast Arctic after a Christmas cruise goes awry, they must rely on the resilience of nature and each other to survive. This film promises a unique blend of survival drama and holiday spirit, set against a breathtaking, icy backdrop.

Bottom Line: 2026 is serving up a buffet of festive films, from sweet romance to chilling horror, ensuring no one goes without their cheesy Christmas fix.

content_raw: Every year, dozens and dozens of cheesy Christmas movies are released. The Hallmark Channel alone often releases over two dozen each year. This means anyone looking for a quick, cheery holiday fix is likely to find themselves swimming in options with no idea where to turn or what might be worth watching. Which is tricky because there can be a very fine line between a cheesy movie that's fun versus one that's too over-the-top to enjoy.
